All weapons is redesigned,and most weapon has manual skill

Defence devices:
all defence devices generate a big energy shield instead of seperated ones.Manual skill will increase the shield for seconds.

Editor:
Add clip size/cast delay/damage per bullet to weapon attributes

3D sound effect
AI improvements:ships will not change target frequecely

Beam lengh bugfix

notes.title: 9.11 Multiplay play mode improvements & Major Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
FINALLY, NERF THE MACHINE GUNS.
[list]
[*]Multiplayer changes: Ships require energy to spawn now. Energy is gained by destroying ships, but ships with weight lower than 100 is free.
Coop mode features normal ships & boss ships, with energy limit of 2000.
Hold the ball features normal ships only. Holding the ball grants bonus energy.

[*]Defense devices cannot block projectiles when they can only partially absorb the damage.
[*]Weapon icons will have a tint when in range in multiplayer
[*]Torpedos now have inaccuracy
[*]Blocks will be destructible even when not at edge. This means a LOT more damaged blocks.
[*]Buffed black holes' speed and made them home in towards enemies
[*]Buffed magnets' distance
[*]Correct ship amount and weight limit is shown when checking other players' ships
[*]Edited the Cannon's projectile and remade physical qualities. It is a missile-based projectile now.
[*]Reduced the Maintenance Unit's noise

[*]Fixed fleet battle's serious synchronizing problems
[*]Fixed map not loading for other clients when host didn't choose team
[*]Fixed unable to collect powerups when host didn't choose team
[*]Fixed repaired weapons not firing
[*]Fixed fleet battle cores attacking ally ships
[*]Fixed hammer AI always fall back at times
[*]Fixed magnets being infinitely reflected
[*]Fixed black holes not moving forward
[/list]

联机模式玩法修改：增加能量点数，玩家需要花费能量购买飞船，能量在杀敌时增加(重量低于100的船免费)
合作模式支持普通飞船和boss飞船，能量上限2000
抢球模式支持普通飞船，能量上限500,抢球后可以获得额外的能量恢复速度

防御性设备(防空炮/能量盾/反弹器)当无法一次性吸收掉子弹伤害时，无法阻挡子弹。
联机模式武器图标在进入射程后变色
增加导弹目标随机性
去掉非边缘方块无法被击落的逻辑，增加方块掉落概率
强化黑洞飞行速度并增加跟踪功能，强化了联机对战时的命中精度
强化磁铁作用距离
查看其他玩家飞船时，可以正确显示对方的飞船总数和吨位上限了
火炮子弹效果修改，物理效果重制
减小维修器音量

联机模式下队伍不同步严重bugfix
联机模式下当房主没有选择队伍时，其他人加入游戏看不到地图bugfix
联机合作模式当房主没有选择队伍时其他玩家无法拾取道具bugfix
联机模式被队友治疗器复原的武器无法射击bugfix

舰队战核心有时候攻击自己的飞船bugfix
部分情况下合体锤子ai无限后退bugfix
磁铁被反弹器无限反弹bugfix
黑洞无法前进bugfix
